solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Spare shift?

definitions.meaning: to spare is to use sparingly, to hold back or skimp on
a shift is a set period of work, a spell on duty

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: as a verb it means to be sparing with something, as a noun a spell of allotted work.

clue.text: Begins to go around breaking law, becoming faithful friends

indicators.note: the verb for beginning is made to go around another piece, wrapping it

parts.note: begins means starts

indicators.note: breaking the word law smashes its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone starting out on a life of crime still somehow ends up with loyal companions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Begins' looks like a verb of setting off, but it is a synonym; 'breaking' makes LWA and 'to go around' wraps it.
explanation.definitionFit: Stalwarts are loyal, dependable supporters who stick by you, a near-synonym of faithful friends.

clue.text: Suggest merely dropping last of reserves

indicators.note: dropping says a letter is let fall from the synonym

parts.note: merely means simply, only

indicators.note: last of picks the final letter of the word reserves

explanation.surface: A hint that something is just a matter of running down the last of one's savings.
explanation.walkthrough: 'last of reserves' is S, which 'dropping' removes from SIMPLY.
explanation.definitionFit: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it outright, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Majority of them criticise year to get treatment

indicators.note: the majority of a word is most of it, so its final letter goes

parts.note: to rap is to rebuke or criticise sharply

explanation.surface: Most of a group knock the year they had, hoping counselling will help.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Majority of' cuts the M from THEM, leaving THE.
explanation.definitionFit: Therapy is treatment for illness or psychological trouble, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Female serves, say, as sop to one's dignity

parts.note: in tennis an ace is a serve that goes unreturned
to aver is to state or say firmly

explanation.surface: A woman playing tennis argues that her serving was meant to soothe someone's pride.
explanation.walkthrough: 'serves' is a noun here: aces are winning tennis serves.
explanation.definitionFit: A face-saver is something offered to let someone keep their pride, a gesture or sop to preserve dignity.

clue.text: Fellow artist regularly guides impostors

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is the crossword's usual artist

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word guides

explanation.surface: A painter who shows tourists around is accused of being a sham.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' takes the second, fourth and sixth letters of 'guides': U, D, S.
explanation.definitionFit: Frauds are people who pretend to be what they are not, which is what impostors do.

clue.text: Spooner's close romance is curtailed

indicators.note: the Reverend Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the starts of the two synonyms trade places

parts.note: to close is to shut
to romance someone is to court them

explanation.surface: A love affair has been brought to an abrupt end.
explanation.walkthrough: Swap the opening sounds of SHUT and COURT to hear CUT SHORT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cut short has been stopped early, exactly what curtailed means.

clue.text: Second best son cries

parts.note: the cream of anything is its best part

explanation.surface: A runner-up and the top boy both shout out.
explanation.definitionFit: Screams are loud piercing cries, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Loved to be involved with city sports venue

indicators.note: letters that are involved are tangled together, so the word loved is rearranged

parts.note: Rome is the Italian capital city

explanation.surface: A city that adores getting involved builds a new stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Loved' reads as an adjective for the city; 'to be involved' rearranges it to VELOD.
explanation.definitionFit: A velodrome is an arena with a banked track for cycle racing, a kind of sports venue.

clue.text: Jockey added clause to contract

definitions.meaning: a jockey rides horses in races
an extra provision tacked onto a legal agreement

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: one who rides a horse, and a supplementary clause attached to a document or bill.

clue.text: What's produced by baker showing skill with computer program

parts.note: an applet is a small computer program
art means skill, as in the art of persuasion

explanation.surface: A baker has a knack for working with software.
explanation.definitionFit: An apple tart is a pastry a baker turns out, so it is one thing such a person produces.

clue.text: Annoyed I was in front after run

indicators.note: after says the following pieces are placed behind the run's letter

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for run
to have led is to have been in front

explanation.surface: Someone is irked: they had been leading after a run.
explanation.definitionFit: Riled means irritated or angered, a direct synonym of annoyed.

clue.text: Wilful manner prior to backing lottery

indicators.note: prior to places the first piece before the next one

parts.note: way means manner, as in a way of doing things

indicators.note: backing means the synonym is read from back to front

parts.note: a draw is a lottery or raffle

explanation.surface: Someone stubborn insists on doing things their way before supporting the lottery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'backing' reads as support for the lottery, but it turns the synonym round to give WARD.
explanation.definitionFit: Wayward describes someone self-willed and hard to control, a synonym of wilful.

clue.text: It's not so easy to embrace love for a miser

indicators.note: to embrace is to hold inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: something not so easy is harder
love is zero in tennis, which looks like the letter O

explanation.surface: Loving a skinflint is a tougher proposition than one might think.
explanation.walkthrough: O (love, a tennis score of nil) goes inside HARDER.
explanation.definitionFit: A hoarder stockpiles and keeps things back, as a miser does with money.

clue.text: Passes on races between teams

definitions.meaning: to pass on a message or signal to the next person
team races where each member runs one leg

explanation.definitionFit: Both senses fit: transmitting something onward, and team races where runners hand over a baton.

clue.text: Biographical account of untruths enveloping female politician

indicators.note: enveloping means wrapping round, so one piece sits inside

parts.note: untruths are lies
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: A memoir full of lies about a woman MP.
explanation.walkthrough: 'enveloping' wraps the untruths round F; a Tory is a member of Britain's Conservative Party.
explanation.definitionFit: A life story is an account of someone's life, which is what a biography gives.

clue.text: Ignore sweeper out of form

parts.note: a brush is a sweeping tool
off means below one's usual standard, as in an off day

explanation.surface: Pay no attention to a defender who is playing badly.
explanation.walkthrough: A sweeper is also a football defender, which drives the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To brush off is to dismiss or ignore someone curtly, an idiom.

clue.text: Take in coppers — cover is solid

parts.note: to take someone in is to fool them
coppers are small coins, pence, P
a roof covers a building

explanation.surface: Fooling the police with a disguise is a safe bet.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' are not police but copper coins: P, pence.
explanation.definitionFit: Something foolproof is so sound it cannot fail, so solid in the sense of reliable.

clue.text: Suspicious behaviour from departing prodigal?

parts.note: departing means going away
the prodigal in the parable is the son who leaves home

explanation.surface: Leaving home like the wastrel in the parable looks like dubious conduct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'prodigal' stands for SON, from the biblical Prodigal Son who departed and squandered his inheritance.
explanation.definitionFit: Goings-on is an idiom for odd or improper activities, suspicious behaviour.

clue.text: After start of season frequently see weakness

indicators.note: after puts the following pieces behind the opening letter
start of picks the opening letter of the word season

parts.note: oft is an old word for often, frequently
to spot is to see

explanation.surface: Once the season is under way, a team often finds its vulnerability.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft spot is a weakness or fondness, as in having a soft spot for someone.

clue.text: It may fill most of road in constituency

indicators.note: in places the shortened road inside the constituency

parts.note: a parliamentary seat is a constituency

indicators.note: most of drops the last letter of the synonym

parts.note: a lane is a narrow road

explanation.surface: Something might fill potholes along much of the road in a parliamentary district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'most of' cuts LANE to LAN, which goes into SEAT.
explanation.definitionFit: A sealant is a substance used to fill gaps and cracks, so it may fill things.

clue.text: Look old, clutching book in summerhouse

indicators.note: clutching means holding inside, so one piece sits within

parts.note: to gaze is to look

explanation.surface: Someone looking aged is gripping a book in a garden shelter.
explanation.definitionFit: A gazebo is a small garden building with a view, a kind of summerhouse.

clue.text: In a case of repossessions, bring up money that's overdue

indicators.note: in places the rearing piece inside the others
the case of a word is its outer letters

parts.note: to rear a child is to bring it up

explanation.surface: In a repossession case, someone raises the subject of unpaid bills.
explanation.walkthrough: 'case of repossessions' is R and S, the outer letters; REAR goes between them after A.
explanation.definitionFit: Arrears are payments that have fallen behind, money owed and overdue.

clue.text: Car crashes in close, bearing north then south

indicators.note: bearing means carrying, so one piece is held inside the other

parts.note: to close is to shut

explanation.surface: Collisions occur in a cul-de-sac as drivers head north and then south.
explanation.walkthrough: 'close' looks like a street name but is the verb; SHUT holds N, then S.
explanation.definitionFit: Shunts is British slang for minor collisions between cars, car crashes.

clue.text: Stigma inhibiting American support

indicators.note: inhibiting means holding in or restraining, so one piece sits inside

parts.note: a stain on one's character is a stigma

explanation.surface: Disgrace is holding back American backing.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain is to hold up or support, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Time in bed? A lot!

indicators.note: in puts the time letter inside the bed

parts.note: sack is slang for bed, as in hit the sack

explanation.surface: Spending ages in bed? Plenty!
explanation.definitionFit: A stack is informal for a great many, as in stacks of money.

clue.text: Sort of car that's difficult to beat?

parts.note: hard means difficult
to top something is to beat it

explanation.surface: A motor so good it would be hard to better.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as 'hard to top', a model difficult to beat.
explanation.definitionFit: A hardtop is a car with a rigid fixed roof, a type of car.

clue.text: Meaningless ceremony after the end of Pentecost

indicators.note: after says the ceremony comes behind the final letter
the end of picks the final letter of the word Pentecost

parts.note: a rite is a ceremony

explanation.surface: An empty ritual follows the close of a church festival.
explanation.definitionFit: Trite remarks are hackneyed and lacking in meaning, so meaningless in effect.

clue.text: Welcome a look and chat inside

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look

indicators.note: inside takes the inner letters of the word chat

explanation.surface: A greeting: take a look and have a chat indoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'chat inside' gives HA, the middle letters of chat.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloha is the Hawaiian greeting used for hello, a word of welcome.

clue.text: Island lost by struggling Minor Asian republic

indicators.note: struggling letters are thrown into disorder, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A small Asian nation in difficulty gives up one of its islands.
explanation.walkthrough: 'lost by' says the I is taken away: MINOR ASIAN rearranged, less I, gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: San Marino is a tiny independent republic surrounded by Italy.

clue.text: Openers needing pitches offering necessary elements of support

parts.note: keys are openers of locks
tones are musical pitches

explanation.surface: Batsmen need good wickets to provide a solid base.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Openers' and 'pitches' suggest cricket batsmen and wickets but mean keys and tones.
explanation.definitionFit: Keystones are the central stones locking an arch, so essential elements bearing support.

clue.text: In almost secure environment, he makes a bundle

indicators.note: an environment surrounds things, so one piece goes around the other
almost drops the final letter of the synonym

parts.note: safe means secure

explanation.surface: Inside a nearly safe setting, he earns a fortune.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims the synonym to SAF and 'environment' makes it surround the pronoun.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheaf is a bundle, of corn stalks or papers.
